EZMB_TEMPORARY.title: Temporary
EZMB_TEMPORARY.description: This card only exists during this combat. It is removed after combat ends.
EZMB_PLANTED.title: Plant
EZMB_PLANTED.description:
Planting is Seedbed's combat-only isolation mechanism: the card is removed from this combat before entering your hand, and you gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Withered Husk[/gold].
Planting is not playing, discarding, or [gold]Exhausting[/gold]. It does not trigger those synergies, is not the same as exhausting a Curse, and does not permanently delete Curses.
· [gold]Temporary Status/Curse[/gold]: Removed from combat and disappears afterwards.
· [gold]Blight Sprout[/gold]: Counted as handled, like solving it for this combat, but not actually played. It adds no [gold]Rootblight[/gold] after combat.
· [gold]Rootblight[/gold]: Frozen for this combat. It does not improve, worsen, split, remove, or clean itself, and remains in the master deck at the same level after combat.
Its strength is the package: immediate Block, one fewer pollution draw this combat, and a [gold]Withered Husk[/gold] that can later Exhaust for Block.
